profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Full-stack Software Engineer working at Google. Graduated from UT Austin in 2016 as a Software Engineering Major. Day-to-day work involves developing primarily Java back-end applications with an Angular 2/4 front-end and NodeJS orchestration. Also worked on DevOps pipelines for different platforms using primarily Jenkins and AWS.

Extensive working knowledge with AWS, Docker, Spring Framework, RESTful APIs, Kafka, Jenkins, and Maven.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop scalable and resilient Java Spring Boot microservices with RESTful API interfaces and communication utilizing Avro-serialized Kafka Messages.

Create and maintain segments of build pipeline including Jenkins jobs, customized Docker images, and a combination of AWS services (ECS, EC2, S3, IAM, etc).

Developed scalable NodeJS components to act as the orchestration layer for an Angular 2/4 Front End to securely interface with separate microservices.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and Develop a connector service with a RESTful API interface to automate user provisioning in 3rd party systems (websites and mainframe) using Java Spring, Selenium and TN3270.

Developed a simple system to perform Machine Learning analysis on Access Data using Scala MLlib, python, and Javascipt.
